description:
Short ranked overview: the most important recent changes grouped by platform. Best first call.

platforms: limit to these platforms (apple, android, google-play, github, vercel, cloudflare, expo, supabase, firebase); default all.
days: look-back window (max 30). per_platform: items per platform (max 10).
Ranking is by importance (AI-rated, heuristic fallback), then recency. Read the source_url before acting on any item.
name: weekly_digest
